# fishextract ![](reference/figures/fishextract-logo.png)

`fishextract` is an R package that aims to simplify, document, and
automate some of the most common functions used in the process of data
extraction and visualisation in OFP data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `fishextract` like so:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("PacificCommunity/fishextract")
library(fishextract)
```

## Main functions

| Command | Description |
|----|----|
| [`get_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_ace.md) | extracts annual catch estimates data |
| [`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md) | extracts operational **catch** data |
| [`get_logbook_effort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_effort.md) | extracts operational **effort** data |
| [`get_n_vessels()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_n_vessels.md) | extracts number of vessels by flag and gear |
| [`get_aggregated_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_catch.md) | extracts aggregated **catch** data |
| [`get_aggregated_effort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_effort.md) | extracts aggregated **catch** data |
| [`get_aggregated_catcheffort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_catcheffort.md) | extracts aggregated **catch** and **effort** data |
| `catcheffort_by_region()` | extracts aggregated **catch** and **effort** data for a given bounding_box which could either be extracted from md2 using [`get_md2_shp()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_md2_shp.md) or custom defined regions using the [`as_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/as_region.md) function |
| [`plot_timeseries()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_timeseries.md) | standardised plotting funciton to be used in conjunction with [`get_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_ace.md), [`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md) or [`get_n_vessels()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_n_vessels.md) |
| [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md) | plot plain pacific map as a ggplot layer |
| [`plot_statistical_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_statistical_region.md) | graphic layer added to [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md) showing statisitical regions (e.g., WCPFC) |
| [`plot_assessment_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_assessment_region.md) | graphic layer added to [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md) showing the stock assessment regions |

## Example usage

### Extracting Annual Catch Estimates (ACE)

``` r

get_ace() 
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"))
get_ace(species = list_species("tunas")) # same as above
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025)
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"))
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"))
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"), ocean = "NX")
```

### Plot ACE data (timeseries)

``` r

ace <- 
  get_ace(
    species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), 
    year = 2004:2025, 
    gear = c("L", "S"), 
    flag = c("ID", "VN")
  )

ace |> plot_timeseries()
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE)
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE)
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE, facet_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE)
```

### Get logbook data

Good to add filters here rather than running
[`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md),
since the output could be quite large and take some time to run.

``` r

get_logbook_catch(flag = "KI") 
get_logbook_catch(flag = "FJ", species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"))
get_logbook_catch(flag = "FJ", species = list_species("tunas")) # same as above
get_logbook_catch(flag = "FJ", species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025)
get_logbook_catch(flag = "FJ", species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"))
get_logbook_catch(flag = c("ID", "VN"), species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"))
get_logbook_catch(flag = c("ID", "VN"),  species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), in_wcpfc = FALSE)
```

### Plot logbook data (timeseries)

``` r

logbook <- 
  get_logbook_catch(
    species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), 
    year = 2004:2025, 
    gear = c("L", "S"), 
    flag = c("ID", "VN")
    )

logbook |> plot_timeseries()
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE)
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE)
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE, facet_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE)
```

### Get number of vessels

``` r

nvessels <- get_n_vessels(year = 2000:2025)
nvessels |> plot_timeseries()
nvessels |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE)
nvessels |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE)
get_n_vessels(year = 2000:2025, flag = list_flags("WPEA")) |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
```

### Plot aggregated data

``` r

get_aggregated_catch(in_wcpfc = TRUE, flag = "ID", year = 2020:2025, gear = "S") |>
  plot_aggregated_catch(
    pie_radius = 3,
    alpha = 0.7,
    colour_by = SP_CODE,
    facet_by = year,
    xlim = c(100, 160),
    ylim = c(-20, 25)
  )
```

``` r

get_aggregated_catch(
  year = 2025,
  flag = list_flags("WPEA"),
  gear = c("H", "K")
) |>
  plot_aggregated_catch(
    pie_radius = 2,
    alpha = 0.7,
    colour_by = SP_CODE,
    facet_by = GEAR_CODE,
    xlim = c(100, 160),
    ylim = c(-20, 25)
  )
```

### Extracting CPUE by region

You can extract an existing assessment region from MD2, and get the CPUE
metrics for a each of the regions. Note that model 130 is the YFT.

``` r

agg_cpue <- get_aggregated_catcheffort(
   flag = "KI",
   year = 2020:2025,
   species = "YFT",
   gear = c("L", "S")
 )
md2_region <- get_md2_shp(model_id = 130)
catcheffort_byregion(agg_cpue, md2_region, show_plot = TRUE, facet_by = GEAR_CODE)
```

… or you can define your own cusom regions.

``` r

custom_latlons <- 
  tibble::tribble(
   ~region_id , ~lon , ~lat ,
   "1"        ,  110 ,   -0 ,
   "1"        ,  110 ,   20 ,
   "1"        ,  150 ,   20 ,
   "1"        ,  150 ,    0 ,
   "2"        ,  160 ,   -0 ,
   "2"        ,  160 ,   -5 ,
   "2"        ,  190 ,   -5 ,
   "2"        ,  190 ,  -10 ,
   "2"        ,  200 ,  -10 ,
   "2"        ,  200 ,    0
 )

custom_regions <- as_region(custom_latlons)
catcheffort_byregion(agg_cpue, custom_regions, show_plot = TRUE, facet_by = GEAR_CODE)
```

## Get length and weight frequencies

``` r

get_lengths(year = 2025, flag = "KI")
get_weights(year = 2020:2025, flag = "AU")
```

### Useful maps

``` r

plot_pacific(show_eez = TRUE, xlim = c(95, 150), ylim = c(-15, 25), eez_flag = c("ID", "VN", "PH"))
```

``` r

plot_statistical_region("wcpfc_epo")
plot_statistical_region("wcpfc")
plot_statistical_region("npo_spo")
```

# Other functions

The `list_*` functions can be useful in automated processes.

``` r

list_species("tunas")
list_species("purse_seine")
list_species("scidata")
list_species("scidata_group1") # scidata standard section 1 bullet point 1
list_species("scidata_group2")

list_flags("WPEA")
list_flags("PNA")
```

The `lookup_*` functions can be useful to automate the processes of
labelling. Note these functions are automatically applied in the
`fishextract::plot_*` functions in the legends and facet labels.

``` r


lookup_flagname(c("ID", "VN", "PH"))
lookup_species(c("YFT", "BET"))
lookup_gears(c("L", "S", "P"))
lookup_fleets(flag = "AU")
lookup_fleets(gear = "P")
lookup_fleets(gear = "P", flag = "ID")
lookup_length_codes()
lookup_weight_codes()
```

### Comparing logbook data and ACE data

``` r


catch_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  get_ace(year = 2000:2025, gear = "S"),
  get_logbook_catch(year = 2000:2025, gear = "S")
) |>
dplyr::filter(!FLAG_CODE %in% c("FJ", "EP", "PA"))

catch_data |>
  plot_timeseries(colour_by = data_source, facet_by = FLAG_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`abbreviate_flagname()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/abbreviate_flagname.md)
  : Abbreviate country/flag names for compact display
- [`as_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/as_region.md)
  : Create assessment regions from vertices or spatial objects
- [`calculate_logbook_coverage()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/calculate_logbook_coverage.md)
  : Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates
- [`catcheffort_byregion()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/catcheffort_byregion.md)
  : Aggregate catch and effort by assessment region
- [`db_connection()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/db_connection.md)
  : Connect to the database
- [`db_query()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/db_query.md)
  : Run a query against a given database (default = FISH_MASTER)
- [`db_summary()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/db_summary.md)
  : Summarise the tables and columns in a database
- [`get_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_ace.md)
  : Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year
- [`get_aggregated_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_catch.md)
  : Pull 5x5 aggregated catch data
- [`get_aggregated_catcheffort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_catcheffort.md)
  : Extract aggregated catch and effort data (either at 1x1 or 5x5
  gridcell)
- [`get_aggregated_effort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_effort.md)
  : Extract aggregated effort data (either at 1x1 or 5x5 gridcell)
- [`get_lengths()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_lengths.md)
  : Get length-frequency data
- [`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md)
  : Retrieve logbook catch data
- [`get_logbook_effort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_effort.md)
  : Retrieve WCPFC logbook effort data
- [`get_md2_shp()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_md2_shp.md)
  : Extract MD2 shape file for a given model number or species
- [`get_n_vessels()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_n_vessels.md)
  : Count vessels by ocean, flag, gear, and year
- [`get_weights()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_weights.md)
  : Get weight-frequency data
- [`label_lookup()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/label_lookup.md)
  : Look up display labels for known ACE grouping columns
- [`list_flags()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/list_flags.md)
  : List the FLAG_CODE values for a given group
- [`list_species()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/list_species.md)
  : List the SP_CODE values for a given group of species
- [`lon_to_360()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lon_to_360.md)
  : Convert decimal longitude (-180 to 180) to 0-360 for Pacific-centred
  maps
- [`lookup_flagname()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_flagname.md)
  : Look up flag (country) names by code
- [`lookup_fleets()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_fleets.md)
  : Look up all the fleets for a given country or gear
- [`lookup_gears()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_gears.md)
  : Look up the gear description for a given gear code
- [`lookup_length_codes()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_length_codes.md)
  : Look up the length measurement codes
- [`lookup_species()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_species.md)
  : Look up the species names given the species codes
- [`lookup_weight_codes()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_weight_codes.md)
  : Look up the weight measurement codes
- [`plot_aggregated_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_aggregated_catch.md)
  : Plot aggregated catch as scatterpies on a Pacific basemap
- [`plot_assessment_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_assessment_region.md)
  : Add Stock assessment region boundaries to a Pacific map
- [`plot_logbook_coverage()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_logbook_coverage.md)
  : Plot logbook coverage by flag and year
- [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md)
  : Plot a Pacific-centred base map
- [`plot_statistical_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_statistical_region.md)
  : PLot Pacific Statistical Region Lines to a Map
- [`plot_timeseries()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_timeseries.md)
  : Plot a timeseries from a given data extract
- [`theme_fishextract()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/theme_fishextract.md)
  : Package plotting theme
